turns.user_utterance: My new card keeps getting declined. I was very excited to use it for the first time today. Why is this doing this?
turns.assistant_response: Sorry about that—card declines on a first attempt are frustrating. To help pinpoint the cause, can you tell me: are you seeing a decline for a card payment in a shop/online, or is it being declined at an ATM? Also, which error message or reason code does the merchant/bank show (if any)?

turns.user_utterance: It happened in a shop – the terminal just showed “transaction not approved” and didn’t give any other code.
turns.assistant_response:
Thanks—since it’s a card payment in a shop showing “transaction not approved,” this is most likely a declined card payment. A few common causes are: incorrect verification (e.g., PIN/contactless method mismatch), temporary merchant/terminal issues, or your card not being fully enabled yet.

Can you confirm: did the terminal ask for your PIN or try contactless first, and have you tried the same merchant again (or a different one)?
